This position requires extensive interaction with cross functional teams. Strong communication skills with relevant services and cloud industry background is helpful. Experience supporting executives and demonstrated FP&A process leadership is desired. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the financial logic and dynamics of the business they support.
cond_0400.responsibilities:
Provide financial mentorship and Business Partner expertise to the business in order to identify areas of risk and ways to improve performance
Drive automation & innovation in finance processes
Lead forecasting and analysis
Lead the quarterly close process, in close coordination with global Finance colleagues
Track forecast accuracy to understand drivers of variances, and share insights with relevant collaborators
Fulfill ad-hoc requests to accelerate growth and to assist in business strategy
Identify and assess key financial performance indicators & metrics to measure & track business performance
Prepare financial information and analysis in support of Quarterly Business Reviews and other ad-hoc senior management meetings
Contribute to annual planning and resource allocation
cond_0400.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6+ Years of relevant professional experience
BA/BS degree in Finance or Accounting
Ability to effectively communicate, both written and verbally, with business partners and offshore resources, to influence and form strong working relationships
Strong data analytical and modelling skills with experience working with large datasets
Utmost attention to detail, strong analysis and research skills; ability to steadfastly pursue a problem to completion
Ability to implement processes and identify cross-functional issues
Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple challenging priorities
Preferred Requirements
MBA
Business intelligence skills with experience in producing flexible, repeatable, succinct reports and dashboards that are highly automated and have few touch points
Knowledge of sales and services organizations, cloud technologies, products, trends and market dynamics
Ability to work independently and adapt quickly in high transparency, high complexity environment
Great teammate with positive, can-do demeanor willing to do what it takes to get the job done right in the interest of the team
Does this sound like you? If so, we hope to meet you!
cond_0400.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0400.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.
